description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which is a UI component in an Android app responsible for displaying a grid of recipe items. It manages view creation, sets up a RecyclerView with a grid layout, and handles navigation to a detail view when a recipe is selected. It interacts with a ViewModel to observe data changes and populate the UI.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a scrollable grid of recipes retrieved from a ViewModel. It handles UI setup, user interactions, and navigation to the recipe details screen.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up recycler view with layout manager and adapter, observes the recipes data from ViewModel, and triggers data loading.
